newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Resolute see new gold province potential.
newsitem.headline: Resolute see new gold province potential.

text.p: Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Friday drilling results from its Indee project south-west of Port Hedland in Western Australia highlighted the potential of the area as a new gold province.
Resolute said results from the drilling of 29 holes at the Camel 1 and Camel 2 prospects included 22 metres at 6.8 grams per tonne, 10 metres at 4.9 g/t and 27 metres at 2.3 g/t.
"Mineralisation at both prospects remains open in all directions, with a number of intersections ending in mineralisation," it said.
The project is about 60 km south-west of Port Hedland. About 80 percent of the area is sand-covered and has received little modern exploration, Resolute said.
The total project tenure covers a total of 2,166 square km, the majority of which is held 100 percent by Resolute.
Previous limited drilling at the two Camel Prospects, returned gold intersections of 15 metres at 3.3 g/t and 19 metres at 3.7 g/t, 1.7 km apart, it said.
Resolute's share price was up 12 cents at A$2.37 at 12.30 a.m. (0230 GMT).
